verdict.what: a two-storey desert trading post or saloon with a striped awning and a domed tower
verdict.style: Old West / desert adobe market town, sandstone and terracotta
verdict.looks: A long rectangular two-storey block on a sandstone plinth. The walls are cobbled sandstone with a smooth stone cap band and crenellated merlon-like corner posts along the parapet. A terracotta band runs between the storeys, with a row of crate-style windows on the upper floor and a lower band of grey-tan stone with terracotta stripes. The ground floor has a open doorway/arch with barrels and crates set in it, and a red-and-white striped awning with dark wood posts runs along the front and one side. A rounded, stepped dome-like cap sits on the roof at the centre, and a taller square tower with an open window rises at one end on the back. Small planters with green leaves and dark-wood posts sit at the corners. The palette is limited to sand, tan, terracotta and dark wood.
verdict.summary: A well-dressed desert market block with a convincing awning, crate windows and a restrained sand-and-terracotta palette, but the domed cap reads as a stacked lid on a box and the massing stays a single slab, so it needs the roof worked into the walls before it's placeable.
